title: Memory Management and Contextual Consistency for Long-Running Low-Code Agents
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: Appendix A reveals that the Figure 2 data (the 'All-Add' vs 'Hybrid System' comparison over 500 turns) is generated by a Python script with HAND-CODED exponential-decay/logistic-drift formulas, with ranges explicitly 'clamped...for realistic visualization' -- NOT derived from real LLM-agent executions. §5.1 itself admits 'Through simulated long-running task experiments' and 'We conducted a series of simulated experiments', without specifying which LLM (if any) actually produced Table 1. Given the appendix evidence, the paper's empirical rigor is doubtful (possibly post-hoc invented data to illustrate the narrative); values are extracted AS THE PAPER PRESENTS THEM but flagged for human review. mem_tipos=TRABAJO;EPISODICA;SEMANTICA: explicit 3-component architecture -- 'Working Memory (WM)' (TRABAJO), 'Episodic Memory (EM)' a vector-DB of timestamped MemoryEntry (EPISODICA), 'Semantic Memory (SM)' of distilled abstract concepts/summaries (SEMANTICA) (§3.1). representacion=VECTOR: Episodic Memory is concretely implemented as a vector database with dense embeddings (§3.1); Semantic Memory is described with hedged/non-committal language ('potentially implemented as a fact collection or knowledge graph') and is therefore not confidently labeled. operaciones=WRITE;CONSOLIDACION;OLVIDO: MemoryEntry creation (WRITE); Algorithm 1 'ConsolidateToSemanticMemory(Mi)' via LLM summary (CONSOLIDACION, §3.3); explicit 'EpisodicMemory.Delete(Mi)' for low-utility entries (OLVIDO, Algorithm 1). trigger=PRESUPUESTO: decay decision by utility-score threshold S(Mi) < theta_decay (Algorithm 1, §3.2.1-3.2.2). retrieval=EMBEDDINGS;RANKING: cosine similarity Ei between memory vector and current-task vector, selection by composite Utility Score (§3.2.1). mide_lectura=NO (matches F_screening, no RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO; §5.2 promises 'retrieval latency' as a Memory Metric but Table 1 does not actually report it). alcance=TAREA: a single long-running task (a multi-week software-project plan, 500 turns, §5.1), no explicit cross-session framing. fidelidad_procedencia=SI: a dedicated 'Contradiction Rate' metric measures when the agent's output conflicts with previously stated facts/instructions (§5.2) -- consistency between recalled and previously stated content, central to the paper's title. F=WRITE;CONSOLIDACION;COSTO;NEGATIVO (NEGATIVO added vs F_screening: the paper explicitly documents the 'self-degradation' failure of the naive 'All-Add' strategy as a central finding, Fig.2, §5.3 -- negative evidence about naive memory management, though the evidence's rigor is doubtful, see RECONSIDERAR). benchmarks=NINGUNO: a self-built simulated task, no standard academic benchmark (§5.1). metricas=EXITO(Task Completion Rate)+COSTO-TOKENS(Average Token Cost per turn)+LATENCIA(Average Latency per turn)+OTRA(Consistency Score, Contradiction Rate) -- Table 1. evidencia_tipo=CUALITATIVA: since Appendix A shows at least Figure 2 was generated with hardcoded formulas (not measured from a real system), and the text itself calls its experiments 'simulated', it does not meet the real ABLATION/BENCHMARK-E2E bar (gate rule 2: 'demos and examples = CUALITATIVA'); see RECONSIDERAR. handoff=NO: memory for a single continuous task/agent, no explicit handoff protocol between distinct sessions or agents. plan_estado=NO: MemoryEntry objects are atomic interactions (message/tool-call/observation), not a dedicated plan/progress object.

title: Agentic Harness Engineering: Observability-Driven Automatic Evolution of Coding-Agent Harnesses
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: this paper's primary focus is offline harness/prompt-engineering automation (an Evolve Agent iteratively edits system-prompt/tools/middleware/long-term-memory as static files of a coding-agent harness across benchmark iterations, section 3), not an agent's own runtime memory-management during a single task; 'long-term memory' is only one of four ablated harness components, and F_screening arrived blank in the input (populated here from full-text read). Section 3.1: memory is a FILE-based harness component (DOCS-ARCHIVOS) written/edited by the offline Evolve Agent based on LLM-discretionary evidence-driven decisions (trigger=DISCRECIONAL-LLM), reverted at file granularity if a next-round verdict rejects it (WRITE/ACTUALIZACION/OLVIDO, Algorithm 1 ROLLBACK step); no runtime retrieval/ranking mechanism is described for how the Code Agent accesses memory content within one task (presumably always fully loaded, like the system prompt) -> retrieval=NA. Table 3 (section 4.4.1): swapping AHE's long-term-memory component alone into the NexAU0 seed raises Terminal-Bench2 pass@1 69.7%->75.3% (Hard tier 51.7%->63.3%, exceeding even full AHE's 53.3% there) -- memory holds '12 boundary-case lessons' (procedural insights on performance margin, queued-over-limit cancellation, evaluator-style closure, source-packaging layout) -> mem_tipos=PROCEDIMENTAL, mide_lectura=SI. Section 3.3/Fig.4: every edit ships a self-declared prediction later verified against next-round observed task deltas -> fidelidad_procedencia=SI.

title: HippoRAG: Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models
senal_calidad: mem_tipos=SEMANTICA: static, corpus-wide 'artificial hippocampal index' built offline from a fixed passage corpus into an open KG of triples (§2.2 Offline Indexing) -- general factual/world knowledge, not per-session episodic user memory. representacion=GRAFO;VECTOR: schemaless KG of noun-phrase nodes/relation edges (§2.2) plus dense-encoder synonymy edges E' from Contriever/ColBERTv2 (§2.3, Table1 graph stats). operaciones=WRITE: one-shot offline OpenIE triple extraction per passage (§2.3); no update/forget/admission logic described. trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA: indexing runs deterministically over every passage in P at ingestion time, no LLM-discretionary write/forget policy. retrieval=GRAFO;EMBEDDINGS: Personalized PageRank over the KG seeded by query nodes (§2.2-2.3) + dense-encoder cosine similarity linking query named entities to KG nodes. mide_lectura=SI: R@2/R@5/EM/F1 extensively measured (Tables2-4). alcance=NA: HippoRAG is a static single-corpus multi-hop QA/IR system with no dialogue-session/task/project/org boundary defined. multiagente=NO, fidelidad_procedencia=NO: no staleness/contradiction handling described. benchmarks/metricas: MuSiQue/2WikiMultiHopQA/HotpotQA (Table1), R@2/R@5/EM/F1 (EXITO) + '10-30 times cheaper and 6-13 times faster' online retrieval than IRCoT (Abstract, §4, Appendix G) for COSTO-TOKENS;LATENCIA. evidencia_tipo=ABLATION (Table5 'Dissecting HippoRAG': OpenIE alternatives, PPR alternatives, w/o node specificity, w/o synonymy edges) + BENCHMARK-E2E (Tables2-4) + MEDICION-COSTO (cost/speed multipliers). F=WRITE;RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO;COSTO confirmed unchanged vs F_screening. handoff=NO: no cross-session/agent content transfer defined (static corpus retrieval, not a conversational agent). RECONSIDERAR: general-purpose multi-hop RAG/IR method evaluated on static QA corpora, not clearly an LLM-agent long-term dialogue/task memory system as elsewhere in this corpus -- borderline membership, left to human reviewer.

title: Titans: Learning to Memorize at Test Time
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: este es un paper de ARQUITECTURA NEURONAL (modulo de memoria a nivel de parametros, integrado dentro del propio modelo de secuencia -- Transformers/RNNs/Titans), evaluado en modelado de lenguaje/razonamiento de sentido comun/genomica/series temporales -- NO trata de un AGENTE LLM interactivo con sesiones/tareas/handoff en el sentido tipico del SMS; varios ejes del formulario (alcance TAREA/SESION/PROYECTO/ORGANIZACION, handoff entre sesiones/agentes, multiagente) simplemente NO APLICAN a un modulo de memoria a nivel de token/secuencia. Se extrae igual por instruccion del protocolo, con la duda anotada para decision humana. mem_tipos: el modulo 'Core' (atencion con ventana limitada) actua como memoria de corto plazo/TRABAJO (S1, 'Titans Architectures'); la 'Long-term Memory' (red neuronal profunda que memoriza en los PESOS a tiempo de test, S3.1) y la 'Persistent Memory' (parametros aprendibles pero independientes de los datos, S1) son ambas PARAMETRICA. representacion=PARAMETROS: la memoria ES literalmente los pesos de un MLP (M_t), un estado matricial/vectorial (S3.1). operaciones: WRITE=actualizacion de memoria M_t=M_{t-1}-theta*grad (Eq.8, explicitamente etiquetada 'Write Operation' en Eq.6 del framework general de RNN); OLVIDO=mecanismo de decaimiento/gating adaptativo alpha_t (Eq.13, 'Forgetting Mechanism' explicito). trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA: la actualizacion ocurre en CADA timestep t via descenso de gradiente, sin discrecion de un LLM externo. retrieval=NA: la 'recuperacion' es un forward-pass neuronal sin actualizacion de pesos (M*(q_t), Eq.15) -- un mecanismo de memoria asociativa parametrica, no un indice externo (embeddings/grafo/grep/ranking en el sentido de memoria de AGENTE) por lo que ningun token del vocabulario cerrado de retrieval aplica limpiamente. mide_lectura=SI a pesar de retrieval=NA: la tarea Needle-in-a-Haystack (NIAH, S5) mide EXPLICITAMENTE 'the actual effective context length of models' evaluando si el modelo puede recuperar con precision una pieza especifica de informacion (la 'aguja') almacenada entre distractores largos -- es una metrica AISLADA de precision de recuperacion/memorizacion, distinta de la perplejidad/accuracy end-to-end -> RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO en F (regla 3 del protocolo no exige que retrieval!=NA, solo que RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO este en F). evidencia_tipo=ABLATION (S5.5, efecto de la profundidad de la memoria en desempeño y eficiencia) + BENCHMARK-E2E (modelado de lenguaje/razonamiento/NIAH/BABILong/genomica/series temporales) + MEDICION-COSTO (S5.5, 'wall-clock training time' y throughput medidos explicitamente). F difiere de F_screening (WRITE;CONSOLIDACION): no se encontro evidencia textual de un operador de CONSOLIDACION (fusion de multiples memorias en una abstraccion); se reemplaza por RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO y COSTO.

title: Persode: Personalized Visual Journaling with Episodic Memory-Aware AI Agent
senal_calidad: Sec.3.2/4.2: memoria episodica explicita ('Episodic Memory-Aware Conversational Agent'; nombre 'Persode'=personalized+episode); pares evento-emocion con timestamps/hashtags extraidos por el Event-Emotion Analyzer desde un buffer temporal de dialogo -> mem_tipos=EPISODICA, operaciones+=WRITE. Sec.3.2 Eq.1: Memory-Strength Scoring S=d(delta_t)*(wE*E+wR*R+wC*C)/(wE+wR+wC), inspirado en la Ebbinghaus Forgetting Curve, 'incorporates memory decay principles to emulate natural forgetting'; 'enabling the retention of significant events while optimizing computational efficiency' -> operaciones+=OLVIDO (decaimiento/poda por relevancia); el mismo score S se usa tambien 'at retrieval time' -> retrieval=RANKING (recuperacion priorizada por el score, sin vector/embeddings ni grafo explicitos en el texto). trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA: el buffer de dialogo se analiza y segmenta en eventos discretos de forma sistematica (Sec.4.2), no como decision arbitraria del LLM. representacion=DOCS-ARCHIVOS (metadata estructurada almacenada en 'the database', Sec.4.1/4.2), no se especifica vector store pese a mencionar 'RAG' de forma generica. Sec.5 Conclusion: 'we plan to conduct extensive user testing... to gather diverse user feedback' -- NO HAY evaluacion cuantitativa (sin ablation, sin benchmark, sin estudio de usuarios realizado; solo walkthrough ilustrativo Fig.4 y el dato suelto 'diary generation takes approximately three seconds' sin protocolo de medicion sistematico) -> evidencia_tipo=CUALITATIVA (misma vara que demos/ejemplos de la calibracion E), mide_lectura=NO, metricas=NINGUNA, benchmarks=NINGUNO. RECONSIDERAR: paper es propuesta de diseno de sistema sin evidencia empirica sobre la memoria episodica (posible caso limite de la calibracion, ver regla E). Memoria persiste 'over time' entre sesiones de journaling del mismo usuario (no single-session) -> alcance=PROYECTO; contenido reutilizado en interacciones/entradas futuras del mismo usuario -> handoff=CONTENIDO. Un solo agente conversacional (no multiagente); sin discusion de procedencia/staleness verificable mas alla del decay -> multiagente=NO, fidelidad_procedencia=NO. F_screening=WRITE; se mantiene igual tras lectura completa (sin RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO al no medirse la lectura).

title: SAMEP: A Secure Protocol for Persistent Context Sharing Across AI Agents
senal_calidad: S3.2 Core Memory API: Store/Retrieve/Search/Update/Delete -> operaciones=WRITE;ADMISION(access-control validation on every op)/OLVIDO(Delete + 'automatic lifecycle management and garbage collection' + 'automatic retention policies')/ACTUALIZACION(Update modifies context metadata). S4.2 multi-backend storage: PostgreSQL/JSONB (structured) + Pinecone (vector) + Redis (cache) -> representacion=HIBRIDA. S3.4 Theorem1 dense-embedding cosine-similarity semantic search -> retrieval=EMBEDDINGS;RANKING (Top-1 Accuracy metric implies ranking). S3.3 hierarchical access-control (public/private/namespace/acl/encrypted, Def.1) scoped by 'namespace' (organizational/team boundary) for regulated-industry (HIPAA) deployment -> alcance=ORGANIZACION. S3.2 audit-trail field on every memory entry (timestamp/action/agent/success) + 'complete audit trail generation' + 'validated HIPAA compliance' -> fidelidad_procedencia=SI. Multi-agent pipelines throughout (4-agent software-dev, 3-agent healthcare, 4-agent multi-modal) -> multiagente=SI. CRITICAL INTEGRITY FLAG (S5.2, verbatim): 'Due to significant variability in system environments, we present PROJECTED performance results based on averaged benchmarks from distributed systems literature' -- Table1/S5.3's 73% redundant-computation reduction, 89% context-relevance improvement, 309% Top-1-accuracy improvement, throughput/latency numbers are NOT measurements on an implemented SAMEP system, they are ESTIMATES/projections. Per rule2 (demos/projections graded like the calibration bar) -> evidencia_tipo=CUALITATIVA only (NOT BENCHMARK-E2E/MEDICION-COSTO despite Table-formatted numbers). Correspondingly mide_lectura=NO (no ACTUAL read-quality measurement occurred) and F DROPS RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO from F_screening; F ADDS FIDELIDAD (audit-trail/HIPAA provenance mechanism). RECONSIDERAR: the entire empirical section is admittedly speculative/projected rather than an evaluation of an actually-built system (no real experiments on SAMEP itself are reported anywhere in the paper) -- flagged for human review of inclusion; the paper's generic 'context data' storage is content-type-agnostic -> mem_tipos=NA.

title: Hindsight is 20/20: Building Agent Memory that Retains, Recalls, and Reflects
senal_calidad: mem_tipos=EPISODICA;SEMANTICA: la red 'experience' (biografia del propio agente en primera persona, S3.1) es EPISODICA; la red 'world' (hechos objetivos externos) y 'observation' (resumenes sintetizados de entidades) son SEMANTICA; la red 'opinion' (creencias subjetivas con score de confianza) se aproxima a SEMANTICA (sin categoria de creencia en el vocabulario cerrado). representacion=HIBRIDA: grafo temporal/entidad-consciente construido por TEMPR ('temporal, entity-aware memory graph', S1) mas embeddings ('generating embeddings' en el pipeline de retain, S3.2) mas indice de palabras clave -- combinacion de GRAFO+VECTOR+texto. operaciones=WRITE;CONSOLIDACION;ACTUALIZACION: retain extrae hechos narrativos, genera embeddings, resuelve entidades y construye enlaces de grafo (WRITE, S3.2); resolucion de entidades y construccion de enlaces integra la nueva informacion en el grafo unificado (CONSOLIDACION); las creencias de la red opinion 'can be updated as new evidence arrives' via un 'opinion reinforcement mechanism' (ACTUALIZACION, S3.1). trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA: 'we process each conversation session through TEMPR's extraction pipeline' (S7.3) -- disparo deterministico por sesion procesada, sin mecanismo de checkpoint/background explicito en esta version del reporte (a diferencia de la version companion W7166866500). retrieval=EMBEDDINGS;GREP-ARCHIVOS;GRAFO;RANKING: 'four-way parallel recall mechanism (semantic, keyword, graph, temporal) with Reciprocal Rank Fusion and neural reranking' (S7.3) -- semantic=EMBEDDINGS, keyword=GREP-ARCHIVOS, graph/temporal=GRAFO, RRF+reranking=RANKING. mide_lectura=NO: la evaluacion (Tabla 3-4) mide accuracy end-task en LongMemEval/LoCoMo via LLM-as-judge sobre la respuesta final, sin una metrica de retrieval aislada de la generacion (no hay tabla dedicada de calidad de recuperacion). alcance=PROYECTO: bancos de memoria persistentes evaluados en LongMemEval y LoCoMo, conversaciones multi-sesion de largo plazo (S7.1-7.2). multiagente=NO: no se describe aislamiento ni comparticion explicita de bancos de memoria entre multiples agentes en esta version del reporte. fidelidad_procedencia=SI: separacion explicita evidencia/creencia (world/experience vs opinion) con scores de confianza actualizables y mecanismo de abstencion cuando falta informacion en lugar de alucinar (S7.2, 'we measure whether Hindsight correctly declines to answer when information is missing'). benchmarks=LongMemEval, LoCoMo. metricas=EXITO;OTRA: accuracy (Tabla 3-4, EXITO -- LongMemEval 39.0%->83.6% con backbone 20B, hasta 91.4% con backbone mayor; LoCoMo hasta 89.61% vs 75.78% del mejor sistema abierto previo, Abstract); correccion/completitud del juez LLM y habilidad de abstencion como OTRA (S7.2). evidencia_tipo=BENCHMARK-E2E: Tabla 3 (LongMemEval) y Tabla 4 (LoCoMo) comparan contra baselines full-context y sistemas de memoria previos; SIN estudio de ablation propio en este reporte (no aparece la palabra 'ablation' en el texto) ni medicion de costo dedicada (el reporte deja placeholders '<add>' sin completar para los presupuestos de tokens de retrieval, S7.3 -- indicio de que este es un borrador/version incompleta del trabajo). F ampliado desde F_screening=FIDELIDAD;RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO: se retira RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO (mide_lectura=NO, no hay metrica de retrieval aislada) y se agregan WRITE (mecanismo central de retain) y CONSOLIDACION (construccion/integracion del grafo de memoria). handoff=CONTENIDO: las memorias recuperadas se combinan con el perfil del agente para generar la respuesta (S3, 'CARA...combining retrieved memories with an agent profile'); no se describe un mecanismo de solo-punteros en esta version. plan_estado=NO: las 4 redes son hechos/experiencias/creencias/resumenes de entidad, sin categoria de plan o progreso de tarea. RECONSIDERAR: este paper (W4417452330, 'Hindsight is 20/20', arXiv 2512.12818, Dic-2025, Latimer/Boschi/Bartholomew mas coautores de Virginia Tech) parece ser una version alternativa o anterior del MISMO sistema 'Hindsight' ya extraido en la ola previa como W7166866500 ('Hindsight: Structured Agent Memory that Retains, Recalls, and Reflects', Latimer et al. 2026) -- mismos autores centrales, mismo nombre de sistema, misma arquitectura de 4 redes y operaciones retain/recall/reflect, pero con cifras de evaluacion DIFERENTES (39.0%->83.6% vs 83.6% vs 60.2% en LongMemEval) y sin los mecanismos de consolidacion en background/freshness-trend descritos en la otra version. Posible duplicado de inclusion en el corpus bajo dos IDs de OpenAlex distintos -- la decision de fusionar/descartar es humana.

title: PBFT-Backed Semantic Voting for Multi-Agent Memory Pruning
senal_calidad: QUALITY/RECONSIDERAR FLAG (integrity concern beyond ordinary low-rigor): the Results section (Sec.V) contains verbatim editorial/meta-commentary that appears to be unedited LLM-generated analysis leaked into the published text, e.g. 'The user's original draft mentioned a 16% improvement; this 88% accuracy represents a substantial level of correctness. (If the 16% was an improvement *over a baseline*, that baseline would need to be defined and tested against)' and 'Further analysis would involve...ablation studies removing the semantic component...However, the current evaluation provides strong evidence for the protocol's viability.' This strongly suggests the reported numbers/discussion were drafted by an LLM assistant without careful human review before submission -- a serious signal for human reconsideration of inclusion/reliability of the reported statistics, even though the architecture description (Sec.III, Algorithms 1-4) is coherent and internally consistent; extracted per protocol, decision left to human reviewer. Sec.III-A: 'These memories are centrally indexed and stored...but the decision to retain or forget a memory item is a collective one' -> mem_tipos=SEMANTICA(generic shared knowledge base, content type unspecified beyond 'knowledge-based systems'); representacion=HIBRIDA(Pinecone 768-dim vector embeddings + SQLite structured metadata/UUIDs). operaciones=OLVIDO(the protocol's entire purpose: 'Co-Forgetting Protocol' for 'synchronized memory pruning')+ACTUALIZACION('Commit Changes: All deletions are then committed...ensuring memory state is consistently updated'); no WRITE/ADMISION contribution claimed (paper addresses pruning of ALREADY-stored items, not initial admission). trigger=CHECKPOINT('an epoch is triggered every 100 agent interactions', Sec.III-D) + EVENTO-DETERMINISTA(within each epoch, decay score D(t)<delta deterministically triggers a forget PROPOSAL, Algorithm2). retrieval=EMBEDDINGS(Pinecone vector similarity infrastructure + DistilBERT semantic relevance scoring). mide_lectura=NO: no evaluation of retrieval/read quality for downstream task use -- only forgetting-DECISION accuracy (vs human annotation) and cache-hit-rate (an access-latency efficiency metric, not a quality-of-content-read metric). alcance=PROYECTO: shared knowledge base persists for the MAS's whole operational lifetime (500 simulated epochs), not task-bound. multiagente=SI (4-agent weighted PBFT voting, 2 planning-weighted + 2 perception/execution-weighted). fidelidad_procedencia=NO: no source/staleness-of-CONTENT verification described (agent reliability confidence ci weights VOTES, not provenance of memory content itself). Abstract/Sec.V numbers: 52% memory-footprint reduction over 500 epochs, 88% voting accuracy vs human-annotated 200-item set, 92% PBFT consensus success under Byzantine conditions, 82% cache hit rate, ~1250ms/epoch latency with 4 agents -> metricas EXITO(voting accuracy, consensus rate)+OTRA(footprint reduction %, cache hit rate)+LATENCIA(per-epoch latency). Sec.V explicitly states NO ablation was performed ('Further analysis would involve...ablation studies removing the semantic component' -- future work) -> evidencia_tipo=BENCHMARK-E2E(500-epoch simulated run)+MEDICION-COSTO(latency measurement), NOT ABLATION. F differs from F_screening(CONSOLIDACION;MULTIAGENTE) [CONSOLIDACION retained as the screening pass's proxy for the closed vocab's absence of a dedicated forgetting/pruning facet]: added SEGURIDAD(PBFT Byzantine fault tolerance directly protects the collective forgetting decision against malicious/faulty agents -- poisoning-adjacent memory-safety mechanism per rule7) and COSTO(latency/cache-optimization results). handoff=CONTENIDO: the shared Pinecone/SQLite memory pool is jointly accessible/votable-on by all agents. plan_estado=NO.

title: Beyond Heuristics: A Decision-Theoretic Framework for Agent Memory Management
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: el propio abstract declara explicitamente 'Our contribution is not a new algorithm, but a principled reframing' -- el paper NO implementa ni evalua empiricamente DAM (ningun benchmark, tabla de resultados, ablacion o medicion de costo en todo el texto completo; la Seccion 4 'Open Challenges' incluso identifica 'Policy-Oriented Evaluation' como un problema ABIERTO para trabajo futuro). Es un paper de POSICION/framework teorico puramente conceptual; se extrae igual por instruccion del protocolo, con la duda anotada para decision humana sobre si cumple el criterio de evidencia minima del SMS. mem_tipos=NA: DAM es agnostico al TIPO de contenido de memoria -- el estado St se define deliberadamente de forma abstracta/generica ('current input, summary of past interactions, auxiliary memory-related information... application-dependent', S2.2.1); NO se compromete a episodic/semantic/etc. -- MIDE (o mas bien, MODELA) el PROCESO DE DECISION de lectura/escritura, no un tipo de contenido especifico. representacion=NA por la misma razon (state design explicitamente dejado abierto). operaciones: WRITE=escritura general de memoria; ADMISION=la sub-politica pi^add propone y evalua (via V^add/Sigma^add) SI agregar un item nuevo -- es control de admision explicito, no escritura indiscriminada (S2.4.2); OLVIDO=sub-politica pi^delete simetrica para eliminacion, explicitamente descrita como de mayor riesgo/irreversibilidad (S2.3-2.4). NO hay CONSOLIDACION ('Memory updates are implicitly represented as a deletion followed by an addition', S2.2.2 -- no fusion de multiples memorias en una abstraccion) -- difiere de F_screening (WRITE;CONSOLIDACION): se elimina CONSOLIDACION por falta de evidencia textual, queda solo WRITE en F (no se etiqueta ADMISION/OLVIDO en F porque no son facetas del vocabulario cerrado de F, solo de operaciones). trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA: la decision ocurre 'at each decision step t' (S2.2.1), un punto estructural del pipeline, independientemente de que politica (aprendida, heuristica o basada en LLM) decida el contenido -- el framework es explicitamente 'agnostic to any particular learning or optimization algorithm' (S2.1). retrieval=NA: la Read Policy pi^read solo se describe como determinando 'retrieval parameters (e.g., query generation or context filtering)' sin especificar mecanismo concreto (embeddings/grafo/grep). handoff=NO: aunque la motivacion menciona genericamente 'persist user preferences and past goals across sessions' (S1), esto es contexto de MOTIVACION, no una afirmacion especifica de que contenido viaja entre sesiones/agentes en el diseño de DAM.

title: Enhancing SWE Bench with Context Engineering: A Comparative Study Against Prompt Engineering in LLM-Based Software Tasks
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: paper reads as likely synthetic/low-substance (single-author, generic citations to unnamed venues [1]-[4] for all quantitative claims, illustrative Python code blocks in Sec 2.3 contain syntax gaps typical of AI-generated pseudocode) -- decision left to human per protocol. mem_tipos=NA per rule 5: paper is NOT about persistent cross-session memory, it measures single-task 'context engineering' (repo history/docs/architecture injected per SWE-bench task, discarded after) vs prompt engineering on SWE-bench success (Sec 2.3 Methodology, 240 stratified tasks, 3 conditions: baseline/prompt-eng/context-eng). retrieval=RANKING: 3-stage pipeline (traversal, relevance scoring, structuring) explicitly scores/prioritizes context (Sec 2.2). mide_lectura=SI: hybrid scoring reports '78% alignment with expert developer judgments of context relevance' (Sec 2.3) -> F requires+gets RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO (differs from F_screening=DOCS-VERSIONADO only). Sec 2.4: context-eng +29.3% avg success on complex multi-component tasks vs +4.2% for prompt-eng alone; prompt-eng +14% on simple single-file tasks. title: Continuum Memory Architectures for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

S2.2 Eq.3: memory evolves via a FIXED composition of all 7 CPTP operators applied EVERY timestep -> trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA (deterministic per-timestep composition, not event/LLM/budget-gated in the ordinary sense). Table1/S2.4 explicit operator-to-memory-function mapping: Irreversible-Loss='low-utility pruning/forgetting' (Eq.9, post-selection+renormalization) -> operaciones includes OLVIDO; Subspace-Mapping='representation transformation/consolidation' (Eq.10, Kraus-operator compression) -> CONSOLIDACION; Liminal='capacity bounds/working memory limit' (Eq.8, soft threshold) -> ADMISION; Table6 defines an explicit Write complexity O(log N) -> WRITE; Cyclic-Reset='bounded refresh cycles/refractory period' (Eq.5) -> ACTUALIZACION -- all 5 non-NA operaciones tokens map onto the 7-operator taxonomy, inferred from an abstract mathematical formalism. mem_tipos=NA and representacion=VECTOR (closest practical analogue to the density-matrix/salience-state formalism): the framework is explicitly content-agnostic, no discussion of WHAT type of information -episodic/semantic/procedural- is stored. retrieval=NA: Table6 gives only complexity classes (Retrieval-cache O(1), Retrieval-store O(log N)) via vague 'Phase Nexter'/'Phase Reverser' operators, no concrete mechanism ever specified.
